firm_data.firm_description: Greenspoon Marder LLP is a full-service national law firm with over 225 attorneys across the United States. The firm has been at the forefront of the state’s real estate and hospitality industries, contributing to projects that have fueled billions in economic activity.
notable_facts: Ranked in Chambers USA 2025 Guide in multiple practice groups
One of the first in the nation to provide dedicated legal services to cannabis businesses

email.to_title: Chief Operating Partner and Chief Financial Officer
email.subject: AI for Greenspoon Marder, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jen,

Greenspoon Marder has built something remarkable across real estate, hospitality, and cannabis law since 1981. With 225 attorneys now managing complex, high-stakes work across multiple jurisdictions, I imagine operational efficiency and risk management are top priorities for your team.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing BigLaw-level demands with leaner resources. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and measurable efficiency gains.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into new markets and would value a brief conversation about how firms like Greenspoon Marder are staying competitive without sacrificing quality.

Would you have 20 minutes for a call this week?

Vasu
Lucio
